description: HM Treasury real time data page for energy consumption is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by HM Treasury. Real time energy consumption data for the HM Treasury headquarter building. Main Building, 1 Horse Guards Road, Whitehall. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher HM Treasury. The portal shows 2014-05-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
